title: Discovering and Interpreting Biased Concepts in Online Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating bias salience based on word frequency and cosine similarity in word embeddings between gender attribute sets (e.g., men vs. women) and target words, followed by semantic clustering, sentiment analysis, and statistical validation using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT).
